epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease the number of unresolved falsification findings across the project from 8 to 0
epics.tocConstraintRef: Uncategorized defect events masking the root cause of design review concerns
requirements: R1: Establish a new invariant pattern to categorize the statistically confirmed design review concerns.
R2: Apply the new rootCausePatternId to the existing underlying defect events.

slices.title: Establish and apply rootCausePatternId for design review concerns
slices.jtbd: When implementing the root cause categorization for this epic, I want to establish a new invariant pattern and apply its rootCausePatternId to the existing defect events, so that the design review concerns are formally categorized and the falsification findings are resolved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a pattern of design review concerns with u=0.0667,
When a new invariant pattern and rootCausePatternId are defined,
Then the ID is applied to the underlying defect events and verified to return the u-chart to centerline 0.0000.
slices.tocConstraintRef: Lack of root cause pattern definition for review concerns
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the reviewConcerns u-chart variation from 0.0667 to 0.0000
